related_records.note: af09289d8bc5930e1 (Knox's plaud-discover fix-verification agent, standalone record eval-20260828T160235-V6V1Q1) was wrongly merged into this record's subagents[] by the SubagentStart-time linking bug fixed 2026-08-28 (eval-agent-start.py now skips linking a spawn that names a different workflows/{name}/workflow.md path than the open parent). Removed here. The real boot-execution subagent (a2d85012d16ba3d83) never got its completion data written into this record at all, due to a second, separate bug: eval-agent-stop.py derived 'the parent' by re-checking which turn record was still open at Stop time, and this record's own Stop hook (eval-turn-stop.py) closed it at 16:07:10.701Z, a few seconds before a2d85012d16ba3d83's own SubagentStop hook ran (it completed at 16:07:48.606Z) -- so the rollup silently no-opped. Fixed by hook_utils.find_parent_record_with_subagent, which looks up the parent by 'does its subagents[] already name this agent_id' instead of 'is a turn record open right now'.

recovered_from.reason: a2d85012d16ba3d83's own standalone type:agent record, written normally by eval-agent-start.py/eval-agent-stop.py regardless of the parent-linking bug. Its full token/cost/model data (recovered here) was never lost -- only the rollup into this record's subagents[]/totals failed.
